messages:
Devon: kicking off a quick safety-scout before we go wide. canary at 5% for rldw-3.2.1 is up, want to run the circuit-breaker sims and smoke checks before 30%.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rldw-3.2.1 -> canary 5% started by @Devon at 2478901234. instances: gpu-a[3], gpu-b[2]. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-20-01

Sam: ack. can you paste the release notes link? want to confirm model pin + quantization profile

Devon: release notes https://internal.rw/release/rldw-3.2.1 notes: pinned model: llama-3-7b-q4, quant-profile: perf-balanced-v2, fallback: llama-3-7b-q8

Maria: running smoke suite now (smoke/small, regression/basic, kv-cache-warm). will report failures inline. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Anita: double-checking routing policy: percentage-based weighted routing, fallback policy = region-first then model-variant. if errors > 2% over 3m we circuit-break to fallback.

Maria: smoke results: small suite ok, regression/basic 1 failing test (tokenizer mismatch on edge prompt), investigating. logs: ```ERROR: tokenizer.decode mismatch at idx 421 - input truncated```

Devon: noted. is that from host gpu-b-2? if so we should pin that instance and drain, not rollback whole canary yet. @ops-bot what do you see on gpu-b-2?

ops-bot: metric-scan: gpu-b-2 shows elevated decode-errors 1.1% over 5m, CPU spikes during kv-cache population. Instance replaced (gpu-b-4) and draining started. trace_id=tr-5590

Sam: ok replacement good. what's our decision on expanding to 30%? need consensus in next 5m.

Devon: propose proceed to 30% after 2 consecutive 1m windows with errors < 0.5% and p95 latency < 280ms. If tokenizer mismatch reproduces, we pin traffic to fallback profile and roll back the build.

Maria: running the 1m windows now. current p95 265ms, errors 0.3% (after replacement). :thumbsup:

Anita: ops-side support: can we set an automated soft-circuit at 0.8% so deploy-bot can auto-attenuate?

Devon: yes, set soft-circuit=0.8% and hard-circuit=2.0%. also enable extra logs for tokenizer module for the next 15m.

deploy-bot: soft-circuit threshold applied (0.8%). auto-attenuation enabled. additional logging toggled for component=tokenizer level=DEBUG; retention=temp-1h

Sam: approved. if we hit soft-circuit it'll drop new sessions to fallback. we should also message support channels and update release notes with the known tokenizer edge (small note).

Devon: updated internal release notes live. proceeding to 30% in 60s if windows hold. calling the go/no-go: @Sam @Maria @Anita please respond with go/no-go.

Maria: go (observability green).

Anita: go (ops ready).

Sam: go. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [rollout] rldw-3.2.1 traffic -> 30% starting. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-20-02. monitor channels: #eng-releases #incidents.

Devon: tracking. if soft-circuit triggers, don't panic — it's expected to attenuate. if hard-circuit triggers, we meet to rollback. leaving this thread open for quick updates.
